summary.zh: 23日失败由24日成功部署接续，保留原失败；207交付与零复核不能合并成已验收。
summary.en: The24th’s successful deployment supersedes the23rd’s failure without erasing it;207 deliveries are not accepted work.

limitation.zh: 作者成果；具体限制见正文；未独立验收。
